notes: Pause: split saved points by segmentBreaks (no line pause↔resume; 1-pt segment = no line). Per pause-segment: skip dup <0.5m; iterative rebound dejitter (heading Δ>120°, both arms ≤30m, acc_i > min(a,b); missing acc→10m; max 5 passes; preserve segment first/last); then centripetal Catmull-Rom α=0.5 through ALL remaining (subdiv=clamp(screenLenPx/2,2,16); duplicate ends within segment only). Meter plane. |Δzoom|≥0.5 → recompute subdiv. Stretch cut per pause-segment; time-order stack; casing 9 / fill 5 / white 0.9 / #1FB873 round caps. GPS/distance/time unchanged.
methodNotes: Dejitter then through-points Catmull-Rom α=0.5; pause-segment isolation; variable subdiv by screen length; dup skip 0.5m.
